title: Straightening charts at regular points of f on M
statement: Let N, m, k ∈ ℕ. Let M ⊆ ℝᴺ be an (m+k)-dimensional C¹ Simon submanifold, U ⊆ ℝᴺ open with M ⊆ U, and f : ℝᴺ → ℝᵐ of class C¹ on U. Assume (hT): for all V ⊆ ℝ^{m+k}, W ⊆ ℝᴺ and ψ : ℝ^{m+k} → ℝᴺ with IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 M V W ψ, and every x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = range Dψ(x). Let x₀ ∈ M with coareaJacobian M f x₀ ≠ 0. Then there are an open set Ω ⊆ P := WithLp 2 (ℝᵐ × ℝᵏ), an open set O ⊆ ℝᴺ and a map Ψ : P → ℝᴺ with the following properties: x₀ ∈ O; Ψ is C¹ on Ω and injective on Ω; Ψ(Ω) = O ∩ M; and for every p ∈ Ω, DΨ(p) is injective, f(Ψ p) = WithLp.fst p, and tangentSpace M (Ψ p) = range DΨ(p).
lean_statement: ∀ (N m k : ℕ) (M U : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m) (x₀ : Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn (m + k)) 1 M → IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U → (∀ (V : Set (Rn (m + k))) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn (m + k) → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) → x₀ ∈ M → coareaJacobian M f x₀ ≠ 0 → ∃ (Ω : Set (WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k))) (O : Set (Rn N)) (Ψ : WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k) → Rn N), IsOpen Ω ∧ IsOpen O ∧ x₀ ∈ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Ψ Ω ∧ InjOn Ψ Ω ∧ Ψ '' Ω = O ∩ M ∧ (∀ p ∈ Ω, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ Ψ p)) ∧ (∀ p ∈ Ω, f (Ψ p) = WithLp.fst p) ∧ ∀ p ∈ Ω, tangentSpace M (Ψ p) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Ψ p).toLinearMap
